tagline: Egg Protein Shampoo – Strength, Shine & Repair
intro: Revive dull, dry, and damaged hair with KB Egg Protein Shampoo, a nourishing formula specially designed to strengthen hair from root to tip. Enriched with egg protein, this shampoo helps repair damage, reduce breakage, and enhance natural shine while promoting healthier-looking hair.

Its gentle cleansing action removes impurities without stripping natural moisture, making it perfect for dry, brittle, and damaged hair. With regular use, hair feels softer, smoother, and visibly stronger.

li: Helps repair damaged and brittle hair

p: Apply to wet hair, gently massage into scalp and lengths to create lather. Rinse thoroughly. Repeat if required.
Ideal for everyday hair care to restore strength, shine, and vitality to your hair

full: Egg Protein Shampoo – Strength, Shine & Repair
